evidence: Full-rank cell set (D1: rank 8 of 8 against the dossier's 8 of 10); positive-control gate G1; emulation-path control; per-configuration LR sweeps with parabolic refinement and fresh seeds; RCBD with seed blocks; registered contrasts with SEs in sigma units; verdict precedence with an omnibus 3-df interaction gate; P2 to P7 with falsifiers; S1 operating characteristics (2,000 replicates per setting over sigma, seed correlation, LR curvature and four truths), revised once before registration; N1 and N2 computations; Phase 0 gates PG1 to PG7 with thresholds and the SR test's power.

the harness and the analysis code do not exist, so no rule has been executed on real data
remediation: Phase 0 J3 and Stage 1a measure sigma; build the analysis and run it as a cpu-doctor orx node on S1's synthetic data
